title: Restore reachable Main Display city and transient rows

purpose: Repair the confirmed post-terminal Main Display layout regression so the already accepted city row and Settings gesture are visibly reachable on the documented generic emulator, without reopening TASK-003 or adopting downstream feature behavior.
success_outcome: The current debug app preserves the accepted Main Display composition and, on Tecno_Pova_6_API_35, renders a non-zero visible city target whose long hold opens Settings and Back returns, with populated shared status/hint rows no longer collapsed and Samsung/custom-ROM evidence still explicitly deferred.
anti_goals: Do not reopen, rewrite, normalize or replace TASK-003, its done status, accepted evidence or terminal scheduler history.
Do not change city gesture semantics, Settings behavior, timer cancellation semantics, forecast behavior or any FT-002 through FT-009 product outcome.
Do not redesign the Main Display, add controls, change accepted text, add a dependency or introduce a new module, graph edge, public contract, state owner or storage path.
Do not create a separate Foundation repair; zero-height Foundation probe controls are only a conditional side effect/gate when the same minimal correction safely applies.
Do not claim Samsung, Android 11 custom-ROM, 1280x720 or physical-device PASS from the generic emulator.
